steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Assault is causing the victim to fear immediate unlawful force — no physical contact is required | Key Fact: Battery is the unlawful application of force to another person — any unwanted touching can amount to battery | Key Fact: Assault and battery are summary offences tried in the Magistrates' Court, carrying up to 6 months' imprisonment | Key Fact: Section 47 OAPA 1861: actual bodily harm (ABH) — injury that is more than transient, including psychological harm
